sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bailleurs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "prenom" TEXT NOT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "rue" TEXT NOT NULL, "complement_adresse" TEXT NULL, "code_postal" TEXT NOT NULL, "ville" TEXT NOT NULL, "telephone" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "biens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_logement" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_location" TEXT NOT NULL, "rue" TEXT NOT NULL, "complement_adresse" TEXT NULL, "code_postal" TEXT NOT NULL, "ville" TEXT NOT NULL, "loyer_hc_centimes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "charges_centimes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "photo_chemin" TEXT NULL, "surface_m2" REAL NULL, "classe_dpe" TEXT NULL, "date_dpe" TEXT NULL, "nombre_lots" INTEGER NULL, "prix_achat_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "frais_notaire_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "travaux_initiaux_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "mensualite_credit_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "taxe_fonciere_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "assurance_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "charges_non_recuperables_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "frais_divers_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "ordre" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "baux" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bien_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biens (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type_bail" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_debut" TEXT NOT NULL, "duree_mois" INTEGER NULL, "depot_garantie_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "date_revision" TEXT NULL, "irl_trimestre" INTEGER NULL CHECK("irl_trimestre" BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "irl_annee" INTEGER NULL, "irl_valeur" REAL NULL, "actif" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("actif" IN (0, 1)), "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "locataires" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bail_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES baux (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "prenom" TEXT NOT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "telephone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "echeances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bien_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES biens (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "titre" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_initiale" TEXT NULL, "statut" TEXT NOT NULL, "faite_le" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "intervalle_mois" INTEGER NULL, "type_diagnostic" TEXT NULL, "automatique" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("automatique" IN (0, 1)), "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rappels" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "echeance_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES echeances (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "jours_avant" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "artisans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "entreprise" TEXT NULL, "metier" TEXT NOT NULL, "telephone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interventions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bien_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biens (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "artisan_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES artisans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "cout_centimes" INTEGER NULL, "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mouvements_financiers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bien_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biens (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "montant_centimes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "categorie" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "intervention_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES interventions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, "modifie_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "encaissements_loyers" ("bien_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biens (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "annee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mois" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("mois" BETWEEN 1 AND 12), "recu" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("recu" IN (0, 1)), "recu_le" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("bien_id", "annee", "mois"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "revisions_loyers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bien_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biens (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "bail_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES baux (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date_prevue" TEXT NULL, "date_effet" TEXT NOT NULL, "ancien_loyer_centimes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nouveau_loyer_centimes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ancien_irl_trimestre" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ancien_irl_annee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ancien_irl_valeur" REAL NOT NULL, "nouvel_irl_trimestre" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nouvel_irl_annee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nouvel_irl_valeur" REAL NOT NULL, "courrier_chemin" TEXT NULL, "cree_le" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "indices_irl" ("annee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "trimestre" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("trimestre" BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "valeur" REAL NOT NULL, "date_publication" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("annee", "trimestre"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reglages" ("cle" TEXT NOT NULL, "valeur" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cle"));
